synopsis: Google’s g2-standard-32 is listed with one NVIDIA L4 GPU, 32 vCPUs and 128 GiB of memory at about USD 1.734 per hour; Chapter 11 identifies this as a 2026 public price, and the glossary repeats the GPU and rate [f8861, f9260, f16064]. Using USD 1.7344 per wall-clock GPU-hour, the illustrative calculation estimates about USD 1,734 for 1,000 GPU-hours, USD 17,344 for 10,000 GPU-hours and USD 173,438 for 100,000 GPU-hours [f8866]. The quoted hourly rates differ slightly in precision, rather than indicating a substantive pricing disagreement [f8311, f8866, f9260]. These figures are arithmetic estimates from published rates, not all-in project costs: software licenses, storage, network egress, orchestration and support are excluded [f8868].
